about.title: About
about.lead: Over 3 years of experience as a vulnerability assessment engineer, evaluating security risks including OWASP Top 10 and business logic flaws.

background.title: Background
background.p1: From April 2022 to March 2025, worked in the security assessment department of an IT company, handling a wide range of tasks including vulnerability assessment of web applications and networks, customer reporting, automation, and education. Handled approximately 30-40 web assessments and about 100 IP network assessments annually, conducting security evaluations based on OWASP Top 10. Used various security tools including Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, and Metasploit, providing end-to-end support from report creation to remediation recommendations.

items.0: Developed automation scripts (Python, VBA) to streamline post-assessment report formatting, contributing to improved business quality and productivity
items.1: Organized industry trends and threat information for clients, reporting and sharing in a format understandable to management
items.2: Continuously researched the latest vulnerability information and attack techniques, actively updating internal assessment methods and knowledge

philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.p1: Prioritize communication with clients and team members, maintaining teamwork and reliability while managing multiple projects in parallel. Engaged in new employee training for 2 years, providing broad guidance from basic security awareness to programming education, contributing to the overall technical improvement of the team.
